correctness.rationale: For unit sphere S^2 and four fixed regular-tetrahedral centers with pair dot product -1/3, radius r in [0,pi], the cap area a=(1-cos r)/2 and spherical isosceles lens b(r) give the p0...p4 distribution by first and second binomial moments. For r<arccos(1/3) no positive-area triple overlap; for r>=that covering radius p0=0; below pi/2 no fourfold overlap. Antipodal complement p_k(r)=p_{4-k}(pi-r) supplies upper hemisphere. Local pair tangency has 3/2 onset and isolated triple/coverage contact has exponent 2 and matching coefficients.
